title: Hosted Data Residency Enforcement — initiative (region pinning + runtime enforcement + audit/obs + rollout)
creator: Naomi Feldman
description:
Goal: deliver an enterprise-grade, enforceable data residency control for Hosted (and Dedicated where applicable) that ensures in-scope data stays within approved cloud region boundaries.

In-scope (v1): prompts, completions, embeddings payloads, request metadata, logs/traces/audit events, and optional persistence features created/processed as part of request handling.

What we are shipping:
1) Configuration model (org/project/workspace):
- pinned_region (single region) and allowed_regions (list)
- clear precedence + validation; safe defaults for enterprise

2) Runtime enforcement:
- Admission enforcement at API gateway/control plane decision point (deny before model execution)
- Routing constraints: deterministic behavior when pinned (no cross-region fallback unless explicitly allowed via exception workflow/override)
- Downstream side effects: storage/logging/analytics pipelines must not write out-of-region

3) Customer experience:
- Machine-readable error codes + remediation guidance (SDK + docs)
- Console UX: settings, validation, recent violations summary
- Audit logs suitable for SIEM ingestion; evidence guidance for GRC

4) Observability + operations:
- Metrics, tracing attributes, dashboards, alert rules
- Runbooks + escalation playbook (Support/CS/SRE)

Non-goals (initial release):
- Automated migration of existing historical artifacts across regions
- Full residency guarantees for legacy datasets not produced via the new enforced path

Stakeholders:
- Product: Naomi Feldman (lead), Lauren Bishop (Dedicated), Vivek Kulkarni (Private), Marissa Cole (Console/rollouts)
- Eng: Ethan Park (control plane), Mina Haddad (routing), Vikram Singh (data plane)
- Security Eng: Marcus Lin; GRC: Olga Petrov
- SRE: Sean Gallagher / Rafael Mendes
- DevEx/Docs: Elliot Price, Wei Chen, Monica Patel (SDK)

Milestones & dates (target; update as we learn):
Phase 0 — Requirements + ADRs + API contract (DONE)
- PRD finalized + design spec in review
- ADR-042/043 drafted + approved
- Error code taxonomy aligned with API Standards

Phase 1 — Core implementation + enforcement + audit/metrics (IN PROGRESS; target complete 2025-03-07)
- ENG-2841 policy model storage + validation + admin APIs
- ENG-2842 gateway enforcement (deny before execution) + error contract
- ENG-2843 routing: disable cross-region fallback when pinned; define capacity exhaustion behavior
- ENG-2844 audit events for allow/deny + violation, export-ready
- ENG-2845 metrics/tracing + initial dashboards

Phase 2 — Console + SDK/docs + canary rollout (PLANNED; target complete 2025-03-21)
- DES-211 console UX designs
- ENG-2846 console APIs + UI hookup
- ENG-2847 SDK: typed exceptions + optional client region hint + docs troubleshooting
- Docs updates (public + internal) aligned with final error codes and screenshots
- ENG-2849 rollout plan: feature flag, canary cohorts, rollback gates

Phase 3 — GA + packaging + enablement (PLANNED; target 2025-03-28)
- Default-on for enterprise plans (Hosted + Dedicated where supported)
- Evidence packaging for GRC + customer-facing security materials
- Support readiness: playbooks, macros, escalation criteria

Pilot plan (beta):
- Pilot cohort is tracked in the CS pilot tracker (Customer Success drive doc). Initial targets include:
  - HubSpot company_10492: EU-only processing + SIEM-ready audit logs required for security review completion
  - HubSpot company_10811: regulated workload evaluating Dedicated vs Private; residency enforcement + exception workflow are blockers
- Success criteria for pilots:
  - 0 cross-region processing for pinned orgs under normal operation
  - Denials happen before model execution (verified via traces) with correct error code
  - Audit event emitted for every residency decision (allow/deny) with required fields
  - Observability dashboards show stable enforcement latency overhead (<5ms p95 at gateway) and no elevated 5xx
  - Support able to resolve common misconfigs (wrong base URL / SDK region mismatch) within 1 business day

GA release criteria (must-have):
- Correctness:
  - Admission check before model execution; deterministic routing for pinned policies
  - No cross-region fallback when pinned unless explicit override is enabled and audit logged
  - Downstream storage write enforcement (logs/traces/analytics) fail-closed with auditable reason
- Customer UX:
  - Error payload includes stable machine-readable code, human message, and remediation hints
  - Docs include configuration examples and FAQ; SDKs surface typed errors
- Compliance:
  - Audit events conform to spec; retention/export pipeline supports SIEM ingestion guidance
  - Exception process documented, approval workflow defined, and expiry enforcement behavior documented
- Operations:
  - Dashboards and alert thresholds reviewed by SRE; runbooks published
  - Canary rollout gates + rollback plan validated in staging

Open questions / risks:
- Capacity exhaustion semantics when pinned: must remain strict by default; any override must be explicit, time-bounded, and logged (Security/GRC alignment).
- Multi-region orgs: precedence rules between org/project/workspace settings need to be unambiguous and easy to troubleshoot.
- Analytics pipelines: ensure region-scoped sinks exist for all supported regions; otherwise fail-closed may surprise customers without clear messaging.
- SDK region hint vs base URL: avoid creating two sources of truth; ensure docs recommend one canonical approach.

Notes:
- Private/VPC deployments: define expected behavior (likely “customer-controlled region boundary”); ensure no misleading guarantees.
- Dedicated: ensure contract language + SLA implications are clear (Lauren + Legal follow-up).

2025-01-17 — Mina Haddad: Routing change will remove cross-region fallback when pinned. We need a product decision on what happens during capacity exhaustion: deny vs allow via opt-in exception. Default should be deny.
2025-01-22 — Marcus Lin: Security requirement: fail-closed for residency enforcement. Any override must be explicit and produce an audit event with reason + approver metadata (or reference).
2025-01-28 — Sean Gallagher: For rollout, we need early warning signals that aren’t noisy. Propose alerts on violation spikes per org + policy-evaluator errors; avoid paging on low-volume dev orgs.
2025-02-03 — Elliot Price: Docs need final error codes and remediation copy, plus console screenshots. Please confirm whether we want customers to pin via console first vs API/Terraform.
